title: Plan der Pavillons in den Giardini, 1934 (ASAC) - Giardini site plan
contents: Coloured site plan of the Giardini in 1934, every pavilion drawn as a small plan with room divisions; 'GRAN BRETAGNA' drawn in full with its internal walls (central hall, side galleries) and the front stair, between Francia and Germania (label crop read).
